017package org.apache.juneau;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.IoUtils.*;
020
021import java.util.regex.*;
022
023/**
024 * Shared test-support utilities for validating XML output.
025 */
026public final class XmlTestUtils {
027
028   // Whitespace-validation patterns.  The lookbehind on the trailing '>' distinguishes start tags ('(?<!/)')
029   // from self-closing tags ('(?<=/)') in a single linear pass, avoiding the super-linear backtracking of the
030   // previous '.*'/nested-quantifier forms (java:S8786).  Hoisted to static final fields since they're
031   // stateless and otherwise get recompiled on every checkXmlWhitespace() call/recursion.
032   private static final Pattern START_TAG = Pattern.compile("^(\\s*)<[^/>][^>]*(?<!/)>$");
033   private static final Pattern END_TAG = Pattern.compile("^(\\s*)</[^>]+>$");
034   private static final Pattern COMBINED_TAG = Pattern.compile("^(\\s*)<[^/>][^>]*(?<=/)>$");
035   private static final Pattern CONTENT_ONLY = Pattern.compile("^(\\s*)[^\\s\\<]+$");
036
037   private XmlTestUtils() {}
038
039   /**
040    * Validates that the whitespace is correct in the specified XML.
041    *
042    * @param out The XML to validate.
043    * @throws Exception If the whitespace/indentation in the XML is incorrect.
044    */
045   @SuppressWarnings({
046      "java:S112"  // Generic exception throw required; checked exception wrapping would obscure test intent.
047   })
048   public static void checkXmlWhitespace(String out) throws Exception {
049      if (out.indexOf('\u0000') != -1) {
050         for (var s : out.split("\u0000"))
051            checkXmlWhitespace(s);
052         return;
053      }
054
055      var lines = out.split("\n");
056      var indent = -1;
057      try {
058         for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++)
059            indent = checkLineIndent(lines[i], i + 1, indent);
060         if (indent != -1)
061            throw new Exception("Possible unmatched tag.  indent=''" + indent + "''");
062      } catch (Exception e) {
063         printLines(lines);
064         throw e;
065      }
066   }
067
068   /**
069    * Validates the indentation of a single line of XML and returns the indent depth after processing it.
070    *
071    * @param line The line to validate.
072    * @param lineNum The 1-based line number (for error messages).
073    * @param indent The indent depth before processing this line.
074    * @return The indent depth after processing this line.
075    * @throws Exception If the line's indentation is wrong, or the line doesn't match any recognized form.
076    */
077   @SuppressWarnings({
078      "java:S112" // Test utility; generic exception mirrors checkXmlWhitespace's diagnostic contract, not swallowed by callers.
079   })
080   private static int checkLineIndent(String line, int lineNum, int indent) throws Exception {
081      var m = START_TAG.matcher(line);
082      if (m.matches()) {
083         checkIndent(indent + 1, m.group(1).length(), lineNum, "start tag");
084         return indent + 1;
085      }
086
087      m = END_TAG.matcher(line);
088      if (m.matches()) {
089         checkIndent(indent, m.group(1).length(), lineNum, "end tag");
090         return indent - 1;
091      }
092
093      m = COMBINED_TAG.matcher(line);
094      if (m.matches()) {
095         checkIndent(indent + 1, m.group(1).length(), lineNum, "combined tag");
096         return indent;
097      }
098
099      m = CONTENT_ONLY.matcher(line);
100      if (m.matches()) {
101         checkIndent(indent + 1, m.group(1).length(), lineNum, "content-only");
102         return indent;
103      }
104
105      var twc = tagWithContentIndent(line);
106      if (twc != -1) {
107         checkIndent(indent + 1, twc, lineNum, "tag-with-content");
108         return indent;
109      }
110
111      throw new Exception("Unmatched whitespace line at line number ''" + lineNum + "''");
112   }
113
114   /**
115    * Verifies that an observed indent width matches the expected one, throwing a descriptive exception otherwise.
116    *
117    * @param expected The expected indent width.
118    * @param actual The observed indent width.
119    * @param lineNum The 1-based line number (for error messages).
120    * @param lineType A human-readable description of the line kind being checked (for error messages).
121    * @throws Exception If <c>actual != expected</c>.
122    */
123   @SuppressWarnings({
124      "java:S112" // Test utility; generic exception mirrors checkXmlWhitespace's diagnostic contract, not swallowed by callers.
125   })
126   private static void checkIndent(int expected, int actual, int lineNum, String lineType) throws Exception {
127      if (actual != expected)
128         throw new Exception("Wrong indentation detected on " + lineType + " line ''" + lineNum + "''");
129   }
130
131   /**
132    * Returns the leading-whitespace indent width of a line that is a single tag-with-content line.
133    *
134    * <p>
135    * A tag-with-content line is one that — after any optional leading whitespace — starts with an opening tag and
136    * ends with a closing tag, such as <c>&lt;foo&gt;bar&lt;/foo&gt;</c>.  This is a linear-time replacement for the
137    * <c>^(\s*)&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;.*&lt;/[^&gt;]+&gt;$</c> regular expression that avoids its super-linear backtracking.
138    *
139    * @param line The line to test.
140    * @return
141    *    The number of leading whitespace characters on the line, or <c>-1</c> if the line is not a single
142    *    tag-with-content line.
143    */
144   private static int tagWithContentIndent(String line) {
145      var n = line.length();
146      var w = 0;
147      while (w < n) {
148         var c = line.charAt(w);
149         if (c != ' ' && c != '\t' && c != '\n' && c != '\u000B' && c != '\f' && c != '\r')
150            break;
151         w++;
152      }
153      if (n - w < 2 || line.charAt(w) != '<' || line.charAt(n - 1) != '>')
154         return -1;
155      var open = line.indexOf('>', w);          // End of the opening tag.
156      if (open - w < 2)
157         return -1;
158      var close = line.lastIndexOf("</");        // Start of the final closing tag.
159      if (close <= open || close + 3 > n - 1)
160         return -1;
161      for (var j = close + 2; j < n - 1; j++)    // Closing tag name must not contain '>'.
162         if (line.charAt(j) == '>')
163            return -1;
164      return w;
165   }
166}
